title: One FPP pool. Several C15 frameworks.
FPP에서 갈라지는 다양한 C15 골격.
intro: Compare acyclic, macrocyclic and bicyclic products from selected FPP-dependent enzymes. Follow the published Alpinia valencene–nootkatone oxidation sequence while keeping framework membership distinct from reactions.
선택한 FPP 사용 효소의 비고리형·큰 고리·이중 고리 생성물을 비교하세요. Alpinia에서 규명된 valencene–nootkatone 산화 경로와 골격 소속 관계를 구분해 보여줍니다.

edges.label: FPP hydrolysis · phosphatase
edges.detail: Farnesol formation by hydrolysis is distinct from TPS cyclisation.

edges.label: Humulene synthase · TPS I
edges.detail: A representative eleven-membered-ring C15 product; minor coproducts depend on the enzyme.

edges.label: β-Caryophyllene synthase · TPS I
edges.detail: The selected common plant beta-caryophyllene stereoisomer is distinct from the positive bacterial product.

edges.label: Amorpha-diene synthase · TPS I
edges.detail: A fully assigned amorpha-4,11-diene reference is shown. This is a scaffold-forming step, not the complete artemisinin pathway.

edges.label: Valencene synthase · TPS I
edges.detail: A (+)-valencene-forming branch. The map does not imply that all valencene synthases are single-product enzymes.

edges.label: Alpinia CYP + CPR · hydroxylation
edges.detail: Published AoCYP6, AoCYP9 and AoCYP18 with AoCPR1 supported beta-nootkatol formation. The selected nootkatol stereoisomer is explicitly defined.

edges.label: AoSDR3 · alcohol oxidation
edges.detail: The published SDRs supported the final oxidation; purified AoSDR3 converted beta-nootkatol to (+)-nootkatone with NAD+ or NADP+. Historical nootkatol names must be checked against the displayed structure.

edges.label: Framework membership
